title: Garage beside bridge ramp, owned by Glass Brothers
description: A. W. Glass ran a garage beside the bridge ramp from 1914 to 1920. In 1918-19, he and his brother Lawnie set up Hartland’s first electric light plant, bringing electricity to the area for the first time. The photo shows Mr. Glass with his nephew, Graem Simms, son of Ronnie and Laura Glass Simms (Mr. Glass’s sister). Observer 1918, “Last week the Glass Bros. installed their new engine and dynamo, and the juice was turned on Thursday evening. R J MacLean, of Woodstock has been here wiring stores and residences and in a few days at least a portion of the village will be electrically lighted”.
